senses.gloss: (b. h. שָׂחַט)to press out, wring, cause to flow.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 22:1">Sabb. XXII, 1</cite> <he>אין סוֹחֲטִין וכ׳</he> you must not press fruits (on the Sabbath) for the sake of the juice. Ib. 144ᵇ <he>היו סוחטין ברימונים</he> they squeezed pomegranates. Y. ib. X, 10ᶜ top <he>הסוֹחֵט והמכבס מלאכה וכ׳</he> wringing clothes and washing are in the same category of labor.
<cite ref="Beitzah 3a:3">Bets. 3ᵃ</cite> <he>שמא יִסְחוֹט</he> lest he may squeeze (fruit); a. fr.—
Ḥull. 27ᵃ א״ת ושָׁחַט אלא וסָחַט וכ׳ read not (Lev. I, 5) v’shaḥaṭ (and he shall cut), but v’saḥaṭ (and he shall get the blood out) &c., v. חָטָא I.
